description:
[Trading Data API] One-call trading verdict for an asset: LONG, SHORT or NEUTRAL bias with a 0-10 confidence, a one-line thesis, entry, invalidation and two targets, and the trend / momentum / structure / liquidity readings behind it — One-call trading verdict for an asset: LONG, SHORT or NEUTRAL bias with a 0-10 confidence, a one-line thesis, entry, invalidation and two targets, and the trend / momentum / structure / liquidity readings behind it. Mechanical scoring from live candles on two timeframes (EMA stack, MACD, RSI, ADX, swing structure, liquidity sweeps, volume point of control), never a guess. BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, NVDA, IBIT, COIN, QQQ, TQQQ, DIA.

**Example:** `/v1/verdict?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h`

symbol.description: Required. One of: BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, NVDA, IBIT, COIN, QQQ, TQQQ, DIA.

timeframe.description: Optional. Execution timeframe: 15m, 1h, 4h, 1D, 1W (default 1h); the next timeframe up is used as context.

name: verdict
